$comment: Aaru colour tokens, the one source for both clients (DESIGN.md "Brand"). Edit here, then run scripts/generate-tokens.mjs: it writes aaru-client/src/tokens.css and the Apple colour sets, and fails when a pair below drops under WCAG AA.

paper.note: Page background. Silver-white by day, the poster's night navy by night; never pure black.

surface.note: Raised: cards, panels, the active nav pill.

stone.note: Sunken: wells, inset fields, empty art.

accent.note: Ice blue, the hologram's colour: primary actions, links, selection, focus.

on-accent.note: Text and glyphs on an accent fill. Never white: white on the dark accent is 2.4:1.

gold.note: The one amber: edge light (hairlines, the next-up ring, the active-nav bar, stars) and the owl's glow while Aaru works. Never a filled surface, never body text.

medallion.note: The silver disc: avatar fills, kind discs, the badge medallion. Between surface and muted so it reads in both appearances with ink on it. The owl sits on night, not here.

scrim.note: Over artwork and behind floating layers: a navy veil in both appearances. Text on it is on-scrim. Art scrims fade it to transparent.

on-scrim.note: Text and glyphs on a scrim: light in both appearances, since the scrim is navy in both.

night.note: The disc behind the owl (mascot and agent mark): the poster's sky, the same in both appearances, so the white owl always reads.

line.note: Hairlines and borders. Navy ink by day; by night the poster's hologram edge, ice blue, so a card separates from the page (surface is 1.1:1 from paper).

line-strong.note: Outlined controls, dividers that must be seen, the ring under a floating layer.

contrast.$comment: [foreground, background, minimum ratio]. 4.5 for text, 3 for strokes, rings and indicators.
